title: The Yearly Foreign Travel Deductible Taken Before the Share Is Worked Out
content:
A yearly deductible is taken from the amount the share is worked out on, when a waiting crossover line under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies is settled. What is taken is settled from the benefit the waiting line falls under and from what has already been paid on that benefit since the policy took effect.

*Where a line waiting on the supplement falls under foreign travel emergency care and no such line has been paid since the policy took effect* — the plan letter's foreign travel emergency deductible is taken in full.

*Where a line waiting on the supplement falls under foreign travel emergency care and such lines have been paid since the policy took effect* — only what remains of that deductible after the liability those lines record is taken, and never less than nothing.

*Where neither of those holds* — no yearly deductible is taken, the benefit carrying none.

### The deductible each plan letter carries

| Policy | Foreign travel emergency deductible |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 250.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 250.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 250.00 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 250.00 |

### Points of judgement

Both of the first two cases require the waiting line to fall under foreign travel emergency care; they part on whether any line under that benefit has been paid since the policy took effect. The liability those paid lines record is what reduces the deductible, and where it equals or exceeds the deductible nothing of it remains to be taken.

### Hypothetical figures

A waiting foreign travel line on Plan G, no such line having been paid since the policy took effect: the deductible taken is 250.00 in full.

A waiting foreign travel line on Plan G where foreign travel lines paid since the policy took effect record liability of 90.00: what remains of the 250.00 after that 90.00, being 160.00, is taken.

A waiting foreign travel line on Plan N where such lines paid since the policy took effect record liability of 400.00: nothing remains of the 250.00, and the deductible taken is 0.00.
